g.text: a) 将皮带张紧器安装在托架两侧的皮带上。
b) 将皮带连接到左侧的皮带夹上。
c) 在皮带夹外侧预留一段长度，
该长度等于两个皮带夹之间的距离。
a) Install the belt tensioner on the belt on both sides of the carriage
b) Attach the belt to the left-side belt clamp.
c)leave an extra belt length beyond the clamp
equal to the distance between the two clamps.

g.onmousemove: ShowToolTip(evt,'4',"0247_M4x6 socket Button head cap screw")
